open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule

section Terms

variable (V : C.left.Opens)

/-- (Implementation) The chart inclusion of the base-changed open into the
comparison-preimage. -/
lemma le_preimage_chart :
    (fst C (overSpec k B')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤
      relCurveMap C B B' ⁻¹ᵁ ((fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  (relCurveMap_preimage C B B' V).ge

variable {ι : Type u} (σ : ι → D.index)
variable (h : ι → Γ(relCurve C B, (fst C (overSpec k B)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V))

/-- The base-changed trivializing family: the images of the generators under the
sections comparison. -/
noncomputable def termFamily (i : ι) :

      "body": "[persistent] [persistent] REPRESENTABILITY PUSH, 2026-07-29 \u2014 the claim/lane protocol that makes 10 free-objective lanes not collide.\n\nWHY THIS EXISTS. This round replaces prescriptive per-leaf tasks with FIVE lanes per project: one REVIEWER and four PROVERS ranked p1..p4. The provers each pick their own target. That only works if claiming is explicit and public. This item is the claiming mechanism. Read it before your first edit.\n\nTHE FIVE LANES PER PROJECT\n- `review-ajc` / `review-ajcr` \u2014 reviewer. Read-mostly. Finds defects of ROUTE and ORGANISATION, not of individual proofs; may propose refactors and file tasks-as-proposals for the provers. Does not race provers for proof work.\n- `ajc-p1` / `ajcr-p1` \u2014 takes the MOST important open representability item.\n- `-p2`, `-p3`, `-p4` \u2014 2nd, 3rd, 4th most important, where \"important\" is measured against the project's representability headline, not by ease.\n\nCLAIMING \u2014 do this BEFORE you start proving, not after.\n 1. `horizon roadmap list --focus <your project's w4-rep / picrep subtree>` and read the reviewer's open notes.\n 2. Pick your item. Check no other lane owns it: an item with `--owner` set to another lane IS CLAIMED. Do not take it, even if you think you would be faster.\n 3. Claim it: `horizon roadmap set <id> --owner <your-task-id> --status active`. If your target is not yet a roadmap item, `roadmap add` it under the right parent first, then claim it.\n 4. Announce: one `horizon inbox add --kind info --to horizon --body \"CLAIM <lane>: <roadmap id> \u2014 <one line on what discharging it buys>\"`.\n 5. Release on exit: if you did NOT finish, `roadmap set <id> --owner ''` and leave a one-line inbox note saying where you stopped and what the next lane should NOT re-derive. An item left owned by a dead lane is worse than an unclaimed one.\n\nRANK IS A TIE-BREAK, NOT A FENCE. If p1's item turns out to be blocked on p3's, say so in the inbox and swap \u2014 rank exists so four lanes do not all converge on the same top item, not to stop you working on the right thing. p1 has first refusal on any contested item.\n\nYOU MAY PROPOSE WORK TO THE OTHER LANES. Direct-message with `horizon inbox add --kind hint --to task:<lane-id> --body \"\u2026\"`. A good proposal names the declaration, the file, and why it is worth more than what that lane currently holds. You may NOT reassign another lane's claimed item, and you may NOT create new horizon runs or tasks for teams outside your own (`horizon permissions` is false on both counts \u2014 propose to the human instead).\n\nSTANDING BINDING DECISIONS you must not relitigate: `I-0491` (AJC: no rational-point binder on the headline; `hasRationalPoint_of_curve` is FALSE and must be deleted, never proved) and `I-0492` (AJCR: `DivFamZar` widens to arbitrary affine opens; do NOT build the GL_2/Aut(P1) route). Read both.\n\nWHAT COUNTS AS PROGRESS, given the 2026-07-29 audit. That audit found 99 of 101 sampled representability claims refuted: 67 sorry-reachable, 17 VACUOUS, 12 hypothesis-shifted. So the bar is explicit:\n- A discharged obligation must be sorry-free AND its hypotheses must be inhabitable. Before you claim a gate closed, exhibit a witness for every antecedent, or say plainly which antecedent is still undischarged.\n- Do NOT add a class, structure field, or hypothesis whose statement does not mention the object it is supposedly about. `HasDivFunctor` is the cautionary case: its field asserted only that a presheaf category is nonempty, `C` did not occur, and it was advertised as the existence of the relative divisor functor. That is a vacuity, and it survived because nobody read the statement.\n- Do NOT discharge an obligation by projecting the hypothesis you assumed (`choose_spec.1` of your own binder). That is `P \u2192 P`.\n- A green `lake build` is not evidence a statement is non-vacuous. Check imports are current before believing a `lean_multi_attempt` success.\n\nCOMMIT DISCIPLINE. This is ONE shared ledger branch with 10 writers. Another lane's integrate sweep can commit your half-written file before you have measured it once. Write risky proofs as explicit `sorry` first, measure, then fill. Stage explicit files, never `add -A`.",

    12	# Descent-backed rank-one certificates for a tied cocycle datum
    13	
    14	This file is the cohomological half of the native family contract.  A certificate is attached to
    15	the displayed `BasicOpenCocycleDatum` and its displayed affine representative; it is never a
    16	certificate for a separately chosen module.  The only geometric input is the fibre witness
    17	condition (the mapped Čech class has a divisor with vanishing `H¹`), from which the datum
    18	dictionary and the rigid engine derive the three cohomological conclusions.
    19	
    20	The descent stage is essential: arbitrary coefficient rings need not be Noetherian.  We descend
    21	the finite cocycle datum to a finitely generated subalgebra, fire the engine there, and transport
    22	`H¹`, finite projectivity, and stalk rank through the on-the-nose datum H⁰ base-change
    23	equivalence.  Thus the public conclusions are genuinely arbitrary-affine, while the only
    24	Noetherian instance is local to the constructed stage.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    29	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    30	
    31	universe u
    32	
    33	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    34	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    35	open scoped TensorProduct
    36	
    37	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    38	
    39	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    40	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    41	
    42	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    43	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    44	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    45	
    46	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    47	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    48	
    49	/-! ## The actual fibre antecedent -/
    50	
    51	/-- A field-parametrised vanishing witness for the *displayed* cocycle datum.
    52	
    53	This is deliberately an abbreviation for the landed `HasWitnessH1Vanishing` predicate.  In
    54	particular its divisor has the class of this datum's cocycle; it cannot be replaced by a witness
    55	for an unrelated module or class.  The stage constructor below asks for this predicate on its
    56	finitely generated descent datum, where every stage residue field is an admissible coefficient
    57	extension. -/
    58	abbrev BasicOpenCocycleDatum.FibreH1Witness
    59	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) : Prop :=
    60	  ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    61	    [IsScalarTower k B L], D.HasWitnessH1Vanishing L
    62	
    63	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    64	
    65	/-- The fibre witness is converted through the landed two-way datum dictionary. -/
    66	theorem subsingleton_pairH1_tensor_of_fibreWitness
    67	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) (hW : D.FibreH1Witness)
    68	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra B L]
    69	    [IsScalarTower k B L] :
    70	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] L) :=
    71	  (D.hasWitnessH1Vanishing_iff_subsingleton L).mp (hW L)
    72	
    73	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    74	
    75	/-! ## The certificate object -/
    76	
    77	/-- The four cohomological certificates consumed by the native presentation.
    78	
    79	Every module in this structure is the H-module of the same `D.sheaf`; no native or unrelated
    80	module can be substituted. -/
    81	structure RankOneFamilyCertificates
    82	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi) : Prop where
    83	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 1)
    84	  h0_finite : Module.Finite B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)
    85	  h0_projective : Module.Projective B (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)
    86	  h0_rank_one : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum B,
    87	    Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1
    88	
    89	namespace RankOneFamilyCertificates
    90	
    91	variable {D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi}
    92	
    93	/-! ## Canonical scalar extension -/
    94	
    95	/-- The canonical H⁰ equivalence attached to a certificate. -/
    96	noncomputable def h0BaseChange
    97	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
    98	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
    99	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   100	    B' ⊗[B] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B']
   101	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := by
   102	  exact D.datumH0BaseChange B' ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   103	
   104	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   105	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   106	/-- H¹ vanishing is preserved by the same canonical coefficient extension. -/
   107	theorem h1_baseChange
   108	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   109	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   110	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   111	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1) :=
   112	  D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B'
   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff D).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   114	
   115	/- The finite/projective instances for a tensor product are installed in the next constructor,
   116	   where they are used to transport the package's source module along `h0BaseChange`. -/
   117	
   118	/-- Scalar extension transports all four certificates, with the target still `D.baseChange`. -/
   119	noncomputable def scalarExtension
   120	    (P : RankOneFamilyCertificates D)
   121	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B']
   122	    [IsScalarTower k B B'] :
   123	    RankOneFamilyCertificates (D.baseChange B') := by
   124	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0
   125	  letI : Module.Finite B Q := P.h0_finite
   126	  letI : Module.Projective B Q := P.h0_projective
   127	  let e : B' ⊗[B] Q ≃ₗ[B']
   128	      Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 0 := P.h0BaseChange B'
   129	  letI : Module.Finite B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   130	  letI : Module.Projective B' (B' ⊗[B] Q) := by infer_instance
   131	  refine {
   132	    h1_vanishing := P.h1_baseChange B'
   133	    h0_finite := Module.Finite.equiv e
   134	    h0_projective := Module.Projective.of_equiv e
   135	    h0_rank_one := ?_ }
   136	  intro p
   137	  rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv e, Module.rankAtStalk_baseChange]
   138	  exact P.h0_rank_one (p.comap (algebraMap B B'))
   139	
   140	end RankOneFamilyCertificates
   141	
   142	end AlgebraicGeometry

    13	
    14	The certificate package uses the canonical datum H0 base-change equivalence.  This file proves

    17	datum, not an equality of proof-valued certificate records.

    43	private lemma appLE_congr_hom {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g)
    44	    {U : Y.Opens} {W : X.Opens} (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    45	    f.appLE U W e = g.appLE U W (h ▸ e) := by
    46	  subst h
    47	  rfl

    49	private lemma cast_appLE_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (hf : f = g)
    50	    {U : Y.Opens} {W W' : X.Opens} (hW : W = W')
    51	    (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e' : W' ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (s : Γ(Y, U)) :
    52	    cast (congrArg (fun V : X.Opens => ↑(Γ(X, V))) hW) ((f.appLE U W e).hom s) =
    53	      (g.appLE U W' e').hom s := by
    54	  subst hf
    55	  subst hW
    56	  rfl

    58	private lemma cast_gluedSubmodule_eq_of_val_heq
    59	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    60	    {D₁ D₂ : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S pi} {W : (relCurve C S).Opens}
    61	    (hD : D₁ = D₂)
    62	    (x : ↑(gluedSubmodule S D₁.pieces D₁.unit W))
    63	    (y : ↑(gluedSubmodule S D₂.pieces D₂.unit W))
    64	    (hval : HEq x.val y.val) :
    65	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C S pi =>
    66	      ↑(gluedSubmodule S E.pieces E.unit W)) hD) x = y := by
    67	  subst D₂
    68	  exact Subtype.ext (eq_of_heq hval)

    70	/-- Comparing glued sections in two stages agrees with direct comparison after transport by the
    71	canonical equality of the two base-changed cocycle data. -/
    72	theorem sectionsMap_tower (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
    73	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
    74	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
    75	    {W : (relCurve C R).Opens} {W' : (relCurve C R').Opens}
    76	    {W'' : (relCurve C R'').Opens}
    77	    (hW' : W' ≤ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ W)
    78	    (hW'' : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R' R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W')
    79	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule R D.pieces D.unit W)) :
    80	    let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
    81	      D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
    82	    let hcomp : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    83	      rw [← relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R''),
    84	        Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
    85	      exact hW''.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hW')
    86	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
    87	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit W'')) hD)
    88	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMap R'' hW'' (D.sectionsMap R' hW' s)) =
    89	      D.sectionsMap R'' hcomp s := by
    90	  let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
    91	    D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
    92	  let hcomp : W'' ≤ relCurveMap C R R'' ⁻¹ᵁ W := by
    93	    rw [← relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R''),
    94	      Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
    95	    exact hW''.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono _ hW')
    96	  change cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
    97	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit W'')) hD)
    98	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMap R'' hW'' (D.sectionsMap R' hW' s)) =
    99	      D.sectionsMap R'' hcomp s
   100	  apply cast_gluedSubmodule_eq_of_val_heq C hD
   101	  apply Function.hfunext rfl
   102	  intro j j' hj
   103	  cases hj
   104	  let hopen : W'' ⊓ ((D.baseChange R').baseChange R'').pieces j =
   105	      W'' ⊓ (D.baseChange R'').pieces j :=
   106	    congrArg (fun V : (relCurve C R'').Opens => W'' ⊓ V)
   107	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_tower C R R' R'' j)
   108	  apply (Equiv.cast_eq_iff_heq
   109	    (congrArg (fun V : (relCurve C R'').Opens => ↑(Γ(relCurve C R'', V))) hopen)).mp
   110	  simp only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMap_coe]
   111	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE]
   112	  exact cast_appLE_congr
   113	    (relCurveMap_comp (C := C) (R := R) (R' := R') (R'' := R'')) hopen _ _ (s.val j)

   115	/-- Global glued-section comparison is transitive along an arbitrary coefficient tower. -/
   116	theorem sectionsMapTop_tower (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
   117	    (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
   118	    [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
   119	    (s : ↑(gluedSubmodule R D.pieces D.unit ⊤)) :
   120	    let hD : (D.baseChange R').baseChange R'' = D.baseChange R'' :=
   121	      D.baseChange_baseChange C R R' R''
   122	    cast (congrArg (fun E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R'' pi =>
   123	      ↑(gluedSubmodule R'' E.pieces E.unit ⊤)) hD)
   124	        ((D.baseChange R').sectionsMapTop R'' (D.sectionsMapTop R' s)) =
   125	      D.sectionsMapTop R'' s := by
   126	  let hW' : (⊤ : (relCurve C R').Opens) ≤
   127	      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C R).Opens) := by
   128	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
   129	  let hW'' : (⊤ : (relCurve C R'').Opens) ≤
   130	      relCurveMap C R' R'' ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (relCurve C R').Opens) := by
   131	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top]
   132	  simpa only [BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionsMapTop] using
   133	    sectionsMap_tower C R R' D R'' hW' hW'' s

   140	private lemma h0Equiv_val_h0BaseChange_one_tmul
   141	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   142	    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :
   143	    (((D.baseChange R').pairData.h0Equiv
   144	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   145	      (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   146	      (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)))
   147	      (D.datumH0BaseChange R' hH1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y))).val =
   148	    D.datumDomBaseChange R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
   149	      ((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   150	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   151	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   152	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val)) := by
   153	  letI := D.projective_sectionsInf
   154	  have hinner : ((datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y) :
   155	      LinearMap.ker ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange R')) :
   156	        R' ⊗[R] ((D.sheaf.obj.obj
   157	          (op (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀)) ×
   158	          (D.sheaf.obj.obj (op (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁)))) =
   159	      (1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   160	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   161	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   162	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val)) := by
   163	    unfold datumH0BaseChangeEquiv
   164	    rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0BaseChangeEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
   165	      LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul]
   166	    change (((LinearMap.ker (datumPair D).diff).subtype.baseChange R')
   167	      ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] (D.pairData.h0Equiv
   168	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   169	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   170	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y)) : _) = _
   171	    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply]
   172	  let e := (D.baseChange R').pairData.h0Equiv
   173	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   174	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   175	    (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   176	  change (e (e.symm ((RigidEngine.kerCongr
   177	      ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange R')
   178	      (datumPair (D.baseChange R')).diff
   179	      (D.datumDomBaseChange R') (D.termBaseChangeInf R')
   180	      (fun x => D.datumDiffBaseChange R' x))
   181	      (datumH0BaseChangeEquiv D hH1 R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y))))).val =
   182	    D.datumDomBaseChange R' ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R]
   183	      ((D.pairData.h0Equiv
   184	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   185	        (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover pi))
   186	        (relCover_sup C R (fiberTwoCover pi)) y).val))
   187	  rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
   188	  refine (RigidEngine.kerCongr_apply_coe _ _ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
   189	  exact congrArg (D.datumDomBaseChange R') hinner

   194	/-- On a pure tensor, the certificate's H0 comparison is comparison of the corresponding global
   195	glued section. -/
   196	theorem linearEquivZero_h0BaseChange_one_tmul
   197	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi) (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   198	    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) :
   199	    Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   200	        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

   202	        (D.datumH0BaseChange R' hH1 ((1 : R') ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
   203	      D.sectionsMapTop R'
   204	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   205	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   206	          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y) := by
   207	  let e := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   208	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R' : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

   211	  rw [e.symm_apply_apply]

   213	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   214	    (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))
   215	    (relCover_sup C R' (fiberTwoCover pi))).injective
   216	  apply Subtype.ext
   217	  unfold e
   218	  rw [h0Equiv_val_h0BaseChange_one_tmul C R R' D hH1 y]
   219	  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
   220	  rw [Scheme.TwoCoverPairData.h0Equiv_val]
   221	  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, D.datumDomBaseChange_tmul R',

   237	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))

   241	        (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   242	        (by rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top])
   243	        (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₀)
   244	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₀ ≤ ⊤)
   245	        (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   246	          (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   247	          isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)).symm using 1
   248	    rfl
   249	  · change D.sectionsMap R'
   250	      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.le_preimage_chart R' (fiberTwoCover pi).V₁)
   251	        (gluedRes R D.pieces D.unit
   252	          (le_top : (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   253	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   254	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   255	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y)) =
   256	      gluedRes R' (D.baseChange R').pieces (D.baseChange R').unit
   257	        (le_top : (relCover C R' (fiberTwoCover pi)).V₁ ≤ ⊤)
   258	        (D.sectionsMapTop R'
   259	          (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   260	            (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C R : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   261	            isTerminalTop D.sheaf y))
   262	    convert
   263	      (D.gluedRes_sectionsMap R'
